description.value: Beaverfoot Lodge is a 97-year-old heritage log building nestled between Yoho National Park and Lake Louise, approximately 40 km from the town of Golden in a remote mountain setting. The property offers lodge guest rooms, rustic cabins, and camping and RV sites, and is a cultural heritage landmark of the Golden region. It operates as a boutique resort and events venue, with a focus on wellness retreats, yoga, and sustainable living as part of the broader Eightfold Mountain Village development.

address.value: 4220 Beaverfoot Rd, Golden, BC V0A 1H0, Canada
